basis.governing_question: What is the current state of patient waiting times at Norte Hospitals Group's three hospitals, and what drives it?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish where and why patients wait at the three hospitals and which improvement areas matter most.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Does the steering group accept the findings and prioritized improvement areas?

workstreams.name: Waiting-time baseline
workstreams.answers: How long do patients wait today at each of the three hospitals, and how do waits compare?
activities: Agree how waiting time is measured with the sponsor
Collect operational data on waiting times by hospital
Compare waiting times across hospitals and patient groups

workstreams.name: Staff and patient input
workstreams.answers: What do the people who work in and use the hospitals see as the causes of long waits?
activities: Interview clinical and admin staff at each hospital
Gather patient feedback on their waiting experience
Synthesize recurring pain points across hospitals

deliverables.name: Synthesis of staff and patient views on waiting

workstreams.name: Patient flow bottlenecks
workstreams.answers: Where along the patient journey do waits build up at each hospital, and why?
activities: Map patient journeys through each hospital
Analyze operational data to locate where waits build up
Test emerging causes with hospital staff

deliverables.name: Patient journey map with wait points by hospital

workstreams.name: Improvement priorities
workstreams.answers: Which causes of long waits matter most, and where should improvement effort focus first?
activities: Consolidate findings into a long list of causes
Rank improvement areas against agreed criteria
Validate the ranking with staff and the sponsor

deliverables.name: Long list of causes and improvement areas
Diagnostic findings and prioritized improvement areas

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope, measures and access
events.decision: Are the scope and waiting-time measures for the diagnostic confirmed?
agenda: Align on the goal and scope of the diagnostic
Review the work plan for the four workstreams
Confirm access to hospital data and staff

events.label: Check-in: findings so far
events.purpose: Review findings and long list of causes
events.decision: Do the findings so far cover the right causes of long waits?
agenda: Present the waiting-time baseline and patient journey map
Discuss staff and patient views on the causes of long waits
Review the long list of improvement areas

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Present final findings and priority areas
events.decision: Does the steering group accept the findings and prioritized improvement areas?
agenda: Present the diagnostic findings and prioritized improvement areas
Review how priorities were ranked and checked with staff
Decide on acceptance of the diagnostic findings

architect_notes: The archetype's Implementation phase is dropped because the engagement is assessment only; acting on the improvement areas is not in this plan.
The archetype's Diagnostic has two workstreams; the plan uses four, as the client asked, adding staff and patient input and patient flow bottlenecks.
